leadForm._help: FREE-MODE REGISTRATION POPUP (2026-11-28). Only when freeSignup.enabled is true AND enabled is true AND endpoint is set: every Book/Register button opens a short form (Student/Parent, name, WhatsApp, optional email, class). It saves the registration to the 'SLA Leads' Google Sheet (google-apps-script-leads.js, deployed as a web app; paste its /exec URL into endpoint), then opens the button's link (the thank-you page, which counts the Google Ads conversion). If saving is slow or fails, the visitor still goes to the thank-you page after timeoutMs. Empty endpoint = old behaviour (buttons go straight to the thank-you page). Preview without saving: add ?leadform=1 to any landing page URL. Paid mode (freeSignup.enabled false) never shows the popup: buttons go to registration.link (webinar.gg later). 'sets' = the class question per page: classInput 'number' (one box, number keypad, 1-12, stored as 'Class N'), 'text' (one box: a number or e.g. 'College') or 'chips' (pro page only: the 'classes' choices), picked by <html data-lead-form="..."> (no attribute = 'all'). 'copy' = wording per page language: en, hinglish (lang hi-Latn), hi (Devanagari).
